title: MLP FIM Season 6 Episode 2 - The Crystalling (Part 2) (1과)

segments.text: I still can't believe you're letting me stay here as your pupil.
Shining Armor's a father!
I'm an aunt!
Your first friendship lesson is going to be...
reuniting with Sunburst!
Uh, yes, that's me.
Yup.
Important wizard.
The baby is an alicorn?
So she could be a super strong flyer.
Without the heart, the Crystal Empire is about to be buried under a mountain of ice and snow.
No!
Protection.
The entire city's about to become a winter wasteland.
But what about when King Zombra ruled the Crystal Empire and the Crystal Heart was missing?
The city wasn't covered in snow then?
The heart wasn't missing.
It was still in the castle.
King Zombra had just hidden it.
I'm afraid Twilight is correct.
And the storm clouds are already forming.
And advise at Rainbow Dash.
Those storm clouds are not like the ones you know.
This far north, the weather has a will of its own.
And now it will only grow stronger, enveloping everything in its path.
Including the Crystal Empire.
And us along with it.
Princess Twilight is keen on the two of us rekindling our friendship, but it's been so long.
I don't see how anything on that list is going to help.
I know, right?
It's not like there's some spell that would magically compel us to pick up where we left off.
Well, actually there's several.
Missed Maine's material amity, Rockville's rapport, Flash Prince's fellow ship.
But I get the feeling the princess isn't looking for a spell.
Definitely not.
Got it.
And if all else fails, ask them to share an embarrassing moment from their past.
Maybe even something they regret.
I don't see how that would help.
Yeah, we should just get out of your Maine.
It's pretty obvious this isn't going how Twilight hoped.
And I'm sure you have plenty of important work to do.
What?
No, right, yes.
No rest for the wizardly.
Come on, Spike.
Perhaps, but it isn't something that either of us know.
The library here at the castle is nearly as extensive as the one in Cantula.
There's a good chance we can find something there.
Can you hold off the storm?
Yes, for a time, but even our magic will eventually succumb to the power of the frozen north.
We will do what we can, but you must hurry.
We'll take to find the right spell.
But you should probably tell the crowd outside to get somewhere warm.
And try not to mention the crystal heart.
We don't want to start a panic.
Yes, ma'am.
Come on, girls!
I'm going to need all of your help.
The crystal library is enormous.
You can count on us, Twilight.
Well, Spike, looks like my biggest fears came true.
I wouldn't be surprised if Twilight decides to give up on me entirely.
It's not your fault.
I'm the one who said all we needed was this list.
It's not the list, Spike, or you, or Twilight.
I'm the one Sunburst doesn't want to be friends with.
I don't remember him saying he didn't want to be friends.
He didn't have to say it.
Well, Twilight obviously thinks she would be friends with, and I do too.
Oh, thanks, Spike.
At least I have two friends, even if one of them has dragon breath.
It's not dragon breath.
It's freezing.
You're right.
But I thought the crystal heart was supposed to keep the cold weather out.
It is.
Unless something's happened.
Come on.
